record.paper_title: TWISTED GGP PROBLEMS AND CONJECTURES, GGP IV
record.original_question: After fixing decompositions of Tamagawa measures and Petersson inner products in the global E ≠ K setting, prove the refined global conjectural identity expressing P ⊗ P in terms of the component-group factor 1/|S_Π|, the ratio L(1, M∨_{U(V_K)}) / L(1, M∨_{U(V)}), the twisted Asai central value L(1/2, Π, As_{L/E} × μ^{-1}), the adjoint L-value L(1, Π, Ad), and the product of normalized local integrals I_v^#.

evidence.quote: As in §2.3, after fixing decompositions of Tamagawa measures and Petersson inner products, one expects a refined conjecture of the following form: P ⊗ P = 1/|SΠ| · L(1, M∨_{U(VK)})/L(1, M∨_{U(V )}) · L(1/2, Π, AsL/E × µ−1)/L(1, Π, Ad) · ∏_v I#_v.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Let $E/F$ be a quadratic extension of number fields with adèle ring $\mathbb{A}_E$, and let $L/E$ be a further quadratic extension such that $K := L \otimes_E F$ is a field (the "$E\neq K$" case, where $K/F$ is also quadratic). Fix a continuous character $\mu : \mathbb{A}_L^\times / L^\times \to \mathbb{C}^\times$ whose restriction to $\mathbb{A}_E^\times$ is trivial (so $\mu$ cuts out the extension $L/E$ in the appropriate sense).

Let $V$ be a Hermitian space over $E$ and let $V_K := V \otimes_E K$, viewed as a Hermitian space over $K$ with respect to the involution induced by $\mathrm{Gal}(L/E) \times \mathrm{Gal}(K/F)$. Let $\mathrm{U}(V)$ and $\mathrm{U}(V_K)$ be the associated unitary groups, viewed as reductive groups over $F$, and let $H := \mathrm{U}(V) \hookrightarrow G := \mathrm{Res}_{E/F}\mathrm{U}(V_K)$ be the natural embedding arising from the twisted Gan–Gross–Prasad setting.

Let $\Pi$ be a cuspidal automorphic representation of $G(\mathbb{A}_F)$ which is tempered and everywhere locally generic, occurring in the discrete spectrum. For a factorizable cusp form $\varphi = \otimes_v \varphi_v \in \Pi$, define the global period
$$P(\varphi) := \int_{[H]} \varphi(h)\, \mu(\det h)\, dh,$$
where $[H] = H(F)\backslash H(\mathbb{A}_F)$ and $dh$ is the Tamagawa measure on $H(\mathbb{A}_F)$, decomposed as $dh = \prod_v dh_v$ via a fixed factorization. Let $\langle \cdot,\cdot\rangle_{\mathrm{Pet}} = \prod_v \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_v$ be a corresponding factorization of the Petersson inner product on $\Pi$.

Let $S_\Pi$ denote the global component group attached to $\Pi$ by the relevant Langlands parametrization, and let $|S_\Pi|$ be its cardinality. Let $M^\vee_{\mathrm{U}(V)}$ and $M^\vee_{\mathrm{U}(V_K)}$ be the motives dual to the motives of Gross attached to $\mathrm{U}(V)$ and $\mathrm{U}(V_K)$, respectively, with associated completed $L$-values $L(1, M^\vee_{\mathrm{U}(V)})$ and $L(1, M^\vee_{\mathrm{U}(V_K)})$. Let $L(s, \Pi, \mathrm{As}_{L/E} \times \mu^{-1})$ be the twisted Asai $L$-function of $\Pi$ relative to $L/E$ twisted by $\mu^{-1}$, and let $L(s, \Pi, \mathrm{Ad})$ be the adjoint $L$-function of $\Pi$. For each place $v$ of $F$, define the normalized local integral
$$I_v^{\#}(\varphi_v, \varphi_v') := \frac{L(1, M^\vee_{\mathrm{U}(V),v})}{L(1, M^\vee_{\mathrm{U}(V_K),v})} \cdot \frac{L(1, \Pi_v, \mathrm{Ad})}{L(1/2, \Pi_v, \mathrm{As}_{L/E}\times \mu^{-1})} \cdot \int_{H(F_v)} \langle \Pi_v(h_v)\varphi_v, \varphi_v'\rangle_v\, \mu_v(\det h_v)\, dh_v.$$

Problem. Prove the following refined global identity: for all factorizable $\varphi, \varphi' \in \Pi$,
$$P(\varphi)\,\overline{P(\varphi')} \;=\; \frac{1}{|S_\Pi|} \cdot \frac{L(1, M^\vee_{\mathrm{U}(V_K)})}{L(1, M^\vee_{\mathrm{U}(V)})} \cdot \frac{L(1/2, \Pi, \mathrm{As}_{L/E}\times \mu^{-1})}{L(1, \Pi, \mathrm{Ad})} \cdot \prod_v I_v^{\#}(\varphi_v, \varphi_v').$$
artifact.status_search_result: The refined twisted global GGP/Asai identity in the $E\neq K$ setting is a conjecture. Recent work (2025) establishes the twisted Gan–Gross–Prasad conjecture for Asai L-functions in any dimension under local assumptions via relative trace formula methods, providing significant progress toward the refined formula, but the fully general refined identity as stated remains conjectural.

status_evidence.title: Central values of Asai L-functions and twisted Gan–Gross–Prasad conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Proves the twisted Gan–Gross–Prasad conjecture on Asai L-functions in any dimension under some local assumptions, by comparing relative trace formulas.
status_evidence.claim: Recent progress establishes the twisted GGP/Asai conjecture under local assumptions, indicating the refined identity is partially solved.

status_evidence.title: Twisted GGP Problems and Conjectures (arXiv:2204.10108)
status_evidence.snippet: Formulates the refined conjectural identity P⊗P = (1/|S_Π|) · L-ratios · ∏ I_v^# in the twisted GGP setting.
status_evidence.claim: The refined identity is stated as a conjecture awaiting proof.
